DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

FNAC REPORT

                                           

 

SITE OF ASPIRATION  :  Right Cervical Lymph Node.

                                            Multiple bilateral nodes. Aspirated from Right Jugulo digastric node.

 

 

 

MATERIAL ASPIRATED  :   Mixed with blood.

 

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS  :    Smears show mixed population of lymphoid cells comprising

                                                    follicular centre cells and few macrophages.

 

                                                    Z.N. stain of the smear is negative for AFB.

 

                                                   No granuloma or malignancy seen.

                                                                 

 

                      

IMPRESSION  :   Reactive lymphoid hyperplasia.

                                                

 

 

ADVICE  :  1) Repeat aspiration if the lesion persists after conservative treatment.

                    2) Follow – up.

 

 

 

ENCLOSED   :   One smear (LG)

                           (SDC/AHT/117/24)

DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

FNAC REPORT

                                           

 

SITE OF ASPIRATION         :  Lymph node swelling left cervical region.

                                                   (2 x 2) cm. firm/mobile.

 

 

MATERIAL ASPIRATED      :   Particulate

 

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS  :    FNAC shows

 

1)    Focal collection of epithelioid cells mixed with lymphoid cells and neutrophils in the background of necrotic debris. 

  

                                                                  2)  No atypical epithelial cells.                                                                    

                                                                 

                                                                  3) No well formed granuloma.

                                                                 

 

                      

IMPRESSION        :   Cytomorphology simulating partially healed Tuberculous lesion.

                                                

                                    NB: Please correlate clinically.

 

ENCLOSED           :   One smear (LG)

                                  (SDC/DK/00/18)

MATERIAL ASPIRATED      :   Particulate

 

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS  :    FNA smears show

2)    Highly Cellular smear showing. Mixed population of lymphoid cells, mostly small lymphocytes.

  

                                                                  2) No necrosis.

DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

FNAC REPORT

                                           

 

SITE OF ASPIRATION         :  Right Posterior Cervical Lymph Node [Upper].

 

 

MATERIAL ASPIRATED      :   Scanty mixed with blood.

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS  :    FNAC smears show

1] A mixed population of normal lymphoid cells.

  

                                                                  2)  Focal collection of scanty macrophages.                                                                 

                                                                 

                                                                  3) Scanty necrosis.

                                                                  

                                                                  4] No atypical epithelial cells.

 

 

                      

IMPRESSION                      :   Cytomorphology simulating reactive hyperplasia of lymph

                                                node with increase in macrophages.

                                                

                                           NB: Please correlate clinically. Direct investigations in line 

                                                  of Koch’s should be done first.

 

 

ENCLOSED                         :   Two slides (LG)

                                            (SDC/SB/00/18)

DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

FNAC REPORT

                                           

 

SITE OF ASPIRATION         :  Swelling left side of Neck.

                                                   (Supraclavicular 3x3 cm Cystic Swelling)

 

 

MATERIAL ASPIRATED      :   Particulate (2.5ml).

 

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS  :    FNA smears show

3)    Few epithelioid cells in the background of caseating necrosis.

  

                                                                  2) No neoplastic cell.                                                                     

                                                                 

                                                                  3) Plenty of polymorphs.

                                                                 

 

                      

IMPRESSION                        :   Suspicion of Tuberculous Lymphadenitis with superadded

                                                   Infection.

                                                

                                                   NB: Please correlate clinically and corroborate with other 

                                                          immuno and radiological parameters.

 

ENCLOSED                           :   One smear (LG)

                                                     (SDC/JB/00/18)

FNAC REPORT

                                           

 

SITE OF ASPIRATION         :  Breast lump Right.

                                                   Size 2 x 1 cm firm/mobile.

 

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS  :    FNAC shows

 

4)    Uniform, benign ductal epithelial cells in large monolayered sheet and bare oval nuclei of benign type.

  

5)    Fibromyxoid and adipose tissue components in the background.                                                                     

                                                                  

                                                                  3) Paucity of inflammatory cells.

                                                                 

 

                      

IMPRESSION                      :   Cytomorphology simulating fibroadenoma breast.  

                                                

 

ENCLOSED                         :   One smear (LG)

                                                   (SDC/NP/00/18)

FNAC REPORT

                                           

FIBROADENOSIS OF BREAST.  

 

 

 

SITE OF ASPIRATION         :  Breast lump Right.

                                                   Size 2 x 1 cm firm/mobile.

 

 

 

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS  :  FNAC shows

                                                                     Smear show duct epithelial cells in small clusters

                                                                     and fibrofatty fragments.

 

                                                                     No evidence of malignancy seen.

                                                                 

 

 

 

 

 

 

                      

IMPRESSION                      :   Fibroadenosis of breast.  

                                                

 

 

 

ENCLOSED                         :   One smear (LG)

                                                   (SDC/NP/00/24)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 


DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

FNAC REPORT

                                           

 

SITE OF ASPIRATION  :  Left Breast Lump.

                                     (2.0 x 2.0) cm. firm, nontender mobile lump in upper outer quadrant.

 

 

 

MATERIAL ASPIRATED  :   Particulate.

 

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS  :    Smears are moderately cellular and show duct epithelial cells in

                                                    branching clusters alongwith scanty stroma. Plenty bare nuclei

                                                    are present in the background.

 

                                                    No evidence of malignancy seen.

 

                                                  

                                                                

                      

IMPRESSION  :   Left breast lump → Fibroadenoma.

                                                 

 

 

ADVICE  :  Surgical biopsy for confirmation.

 

 

ENCLOSED   :   Two smears (LG)

                           (SDC/AK/137/24)
